library.heroBody: Browse starter Sections and Site Kit atoms in the Kit Playground. Publish still syncs package CSF to Coolify Storybook when you need a rebuild.

library.atomsLead: Closed atom + layout catalog — same ids as the editor insert palette.

kit.lead: Browse Atoms, starter Sections, and Collection Patterns. Edit TSX freely — Reset restores the seed. Nothing is written to Site Kit SSOT.
kit.navSectionsHint: Landing teaching bands — scene Masters, not Kit SSOT. Save as Pattern from the editor to publish.
kit.patternsEmpty: No Patterns for this Collection (bind a Collection or save a Pattern from the editor).
kit.ephemeralHint: Edits stay in this browser session only. Publish / Write in the editor still owns durable Site Kit changes.
kit.sandboxOk: Sucrase transpile OK — preview uses Site Kit CompositionPreview
kit.propsPathMissing: Selected path is gone — pick root or another node.
kit.propsEmpty: Select a component to edit props
kit.propsNone: No simple root props on this tree (edit TSX instead)
kit.propsHint: Prop and token edits stay ephemeral — they rewrite the TSX sandbox, not Site Kit SSOT. Pick token paths here or open the Tokens tab for the full pack.
kit.handoffEmpty: Select a component for install, import, and copy-ready module
kit.handoffTokensBoardEmpty: No tokenBindings on this composition yet — open the Tokens tab for the full design-token pack.
kit.handoffSectionNote: Starter landing band — scene Master seed, not Kit SSOT. Save as Site Kit component in the editor to publish a Pattern.
kit.handoffTokensNote: Preview paint resolves the active design-token pack (or seed) tokenBindings into style. Consumer apps bind the same tokens.
kit.handoffDsTokensNote: Copied module maps tokenBindings to var(--ds-*). Load the Zaoly local pack :root CSS (or Token Studio CSS dump) in the consumer app.
kit.handoffTokenPackCssEmpty: No resolvable design-token digital leaves for CSS export yet.
kit.handoffCdnPatternNote: Patterns are Collection-scoped — not on the public atom CDN. Use the scoped package import path above.
kit.handoffAtomSourceError: Could not load package atom source.
kit.handoffAtomSourcePatternNote: Patterns are compositions — there is no single package atom file. Use Expanded module or Composition JSON. Storybook CSF is for package hydrate.
kit.seedDiffError: Could not load catalog seed for diff.
kit.seedDiffPatternNote: Seed diff compares catalog atom playground TSX to the current seed — Patterns have no catalog atom base. Use Expanded module / Composition JSON.
kit.handoffAllowedPropsNone: No contract props for this root type
kit.handoffPaintNote: Layout/paint keys (gap, color, padding, …) belong in style — not composition props.
kit.maintainerStorybookNote: Coolify Storybook is package / CSF hydrate — daily browse stays on this Playground.
kit.maintainerPullHint: Compare kitRevision in the Editor and use Pull from Site Kit when Masters are behind. Playground never pulls or writes SSOT.
kit.patternFlowHint: Durable Patterns: in the Editor create a Master, then Save as Site Kit component. Playground TSX never writes Site Kit SSOT.
kit.persistHint: Sandbox only — durable save is via Editor → Site Kit Publish (playground TSX is never written to SSOT).
